name: wrenfield-orders-api-memory-bench
checks: bench/check.mjs validates dataset integrity (task/gold pairing, gold commits resolve, gold paths exist at repo_rev). bench/check-answers.mjs validates the answer checks themselves: it runs the real score() over bench/answer-fixtures.json (reversed answers must fail, right answers must pass).
scoring: Each gold/<id>.json check asserts the ANSWER's content and direction: must_mention groups (each needs >=1 regex hit, case-insensitive; trap tasks require the stale/wrong source flagged near its name), forbid_mention (none may hit; trap tasks reject affirmative reversed claims), cite_path (a cited path matching each regex must exist in the repo), cite_commit (a cited sha-prefix matching each regex must resolve in git).
exclusion: bench/ is evaluation-only. A harness MUST exclude bench/** from every retrieval surface: file reads, search, git log/show of bench paths, and the working tree if visible to the evaluated agent.
